about: Every secret and setting the House's code reads, and every credential held only in a vendor's dashboard (WORKLIST P0.60): what it is, who holds it, and, for a secret, how it is rotated. Names only, never a value. everySecretIsInventoried.test.ts fails when a name the code reads is missing here: a Deno.env name in either functions tree, a process.env name in api/, mobile/scripts/, mobile/supabase/diagnostics/ or mobile/e2e/, a secret a workflow names, a Vault secret the schema reads, an eas.json build setting. kind: secret (rotate it if it leaks), public (ships in an app or page by design), setting (no secret: an address, a switch, a run's own value), made (made fresh for one CI run, never kept).

entries.name: SUPABASE_URL
entries.is: The project's API address, given to every function by Supabase.

entries.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
entries.is: The legacy anon key, given to every function by Supabase; it ships in both apps.

entries.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
entries.is: The legacy service-role key: every row, past every rule. Given to every function by Supabase.
entries.rotation: Project Settings → API → JWT secret → generate a new one (this changes the anon key too: both apps need a new build or update, so plan it with a release); then redeploy every function and check npm run functions:check.

entries.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEYS
entries.is: The project's new secret API keys (sb_secret_…), given to every function by Supabase; sign-in-with-username checks a password with the 'default' one and forwards the caller's address to Auth (P3.12).
entries.rotation: Project Settings → API Keys → create a new secret key named default, redeploy sign-in-with-username, then delete the old key.

entries.name: FUNCTION_SHARED_SECRET
entries.is: The secret notify-push and send-email ask for in x-function-secret; the database sends notify-push the same value from the Vault (notify_push_secret).
entries.rotation: Set the new value in both places in one sitting: supabase secrets set FUNCTION_SHARED_SECRET=… and SELECT vault.update_secret(id, …) for notify_push_secret; then send one notice and see its push arrive.

entries.name: notify_push_secret
entries.is: The Vault's copy of FUNCTION_SHARED_SECRET, which tg_notify_push sends with each push.
entries.rotation: With FUNCTION_SHARED_SECRET, as above.

entries.name: EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.is: Expo's access token for push, once push security is on (P0.22a): a robot's token with the push role only.
entries.rotation: expo.dev → account → Access tokens: make a new robot token, supabase secrets set EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN=…, redeploy notify-push, send one notice, then revoke the old token.

entries.name: EXPO_PUSH_URL
entries.is: Expo's push address; unset in production (Expo's own), the sealed world's stand-in in CI.

entries.name: REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY
entries.is: RevenueCat's secret API key, to read a member's whole record (sync-entitlement, revenuecat-webhook).
entries.rotation: RevenueCat → API keys → new secret key (v1), supabase secrets set REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY=…, redeploy both functions, then revoke the old key.

entries.name: REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.is: The Authorization header RevenueCat sends with each webhook.
entries.rotation: Set a new value in RevenueCat's webhook settings and with supabase secrets set in the same minute; send RevenueCat's test event and see it answered 200.

entries.name: REVENUECAT_API_URL
entries.is: RevenueCat's API address; unset in production, the stand-in in CI.

entries.name: TMDB_API_KEY
entries.is: TMDB's API key: tmdb-proxy and sync-films use it in Supabase; the website's share images (api/og.js) in Vercel.
entries.rotation: PLAN §3c-1's order: a new key at themoviedb.org → supabase secrets set TMDB_API_KEY=… and Vercel's TMDB_API_KEY → redeploy tmdb-proxy and sync-films → read one film through the proxy → revoke the old key → prove the old key is refused.

entries.name: TMDB_ORIGIN
entries.is: TMDB's address; unset in production, the stand-in in CI.

entries.name: TMDB_READ_TOKEN
entries.is: A TMDB read token a script reads from the environment (never committed).
holders: whoever runs the script, in their own shell
entries.rotation: With TMDB_API_KEY: a new token at themoviedb.org, the old one revoked.

entries.name: VITE_TMDB_API_KEY
entries.is: An old website setting a script still names; the website reads TMDB through the proxy.
holders: none (the website no longer holds it)
entries.rotation: Retired with the old key (§3c-1).

entries.name: VITE_TMDB_READ_URL
entries.is: The website's TMDB address, as a script reads it.

entries.name: FEED_ORIGIN
entries.is: The feed host's address for fetch-rss; unset in production, the stand-in in CI.

entries.name: RESEND_API_KEY
entries.is: Resend's API key for send-email (not deployed); Auth's own mail uses the SMTP key below.
entries.rotation: resend.com → API keys: a new key, supabase secrets set RESEND_API_KEY=…, then delete the old key.

entries.name: RESEND_API_URL
entries.is: Resend's address; unset in production, the stand-in in CI.

entries.name: PAYTABS_PROFILE_ID
entries.is: PayTabs' profile id for paytabs-handler (not deployed).
holders: none until web payments are built

entries.name: PAYTABS_SERVER_KEY
entries.is: PayTabs' server key for paytabs-handler (not deployed).
holders: none until web payments are built
entries.rotation: PayTabs merchant dashboard → a new server key, set as a function secret, the old one revoked.

entries.name: PAYTABS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.is: The secret on PayTabs' callback to paytabs-handler (not deployed).
holders: none until web payments are built
entries.rotation: Set a new value in PayTabs and as a function secret in the same minute.

entries.name: NODE_ENV
entries.is: A switch paytabs-handler reads for its allowed origin.

entries.name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
entries.is: Production's database address with its password: read-only checks and the train read it from the private settings file, never the repo.
entries.rotation: Project Settings → Database → reset the password (P0.0a), write the new address with scripts/private-settings.cjs, and show the old one refused.

entries.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
entries.is: The project's id, in the private settings file beside the address.

entries.name: REELHOUSE_PRIVATE
entries.is: Where the private settings file is, when not in its usual folder.

entries.name: SNAPSHOT_DB_URL
entries.is: The database the snapshot check reads: the sealed copy in CI; production only through the private settings file.

entries.name: SNAPSHOT_SAME_MAJOR
entries.is: A switch for the snapshot check in CI.

entries.name: LOAD_DB_URL
entries.is: The load test's sealed database.

entries.name: LAB_DB_URL
entries.is: The speed lab's sealed database, which its seed fills.

entries.name: E2E_DB_HOST
entries.is: The sealed database's host.

entries.name: E2E_DB_PORT
entries.is: The sealed database's port.

entries.name: E2E_PROD_IPS
entries.is: Production's addresses the seal refused, for bootstrap to prove from inside.

entries.name: E2E_FLOWS
entries.is: Which flows a shard runs.

entries.name: E2E_OLD_CLIENT
entries.is: Which shipped client an E2E run is.

entries.name: E2E_SEED_WALK
entries.is: Whether the seed also makes the route walk's writer and their rooms (a variant run).

entries.name: E2E_MEMBER_USERNAME
entries.is: The sealed world's seeded member's handle.

entries.name: E2E_MEMBER_PASSWORD
entries.is: The seeded member's password, made fresh each run and masked.

entries.name: API_URL
entries.is: The local stack's API address (supabase status).

entries.name: ANON_KEY
entries.is: The local stack's anon key (supabase status); a sealed world's, never production's.

entries.name: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
entries.is: The local stack's service-role key; a sealed world's, never production's.

entries.name: FN_DB_URL
entries.is: The functions world's database (local).

entries.name: FN_GATEWAY_FROM_DB
entries.is: The local gateway as the database's container reaches it.

entries.name: FN_FUNCTION_SHARED_SECRET
entries.is: The functions world's own FUNCTION_SHARED_SECRET, made by place.mjs for one run.

entries.name: FN_RESEND_API_KEY
entries.is: The functions world's own RESEND_API_KEY, made for one run.

entries.name: FN_REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY
entries.is: The functions world's own REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY, made for one run.

entries.name: FN_REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.is: The functions world's own REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET, made for one run.

entries.name: FN_TMDB_API_KEY
entries.is: The functions world's own TMDB_API_KEY, made for one run.

entries.name: STAND_INS_EXPO_TOKEN
entries.is: The fixed, non-secret Expo token the functions world gives notify-push and its Expo stand-in.

entries.name: STAND_INS_PORT
entries.is: The stand-ins' port.

entries.name: STAND_INS_URL
entries.is: The stand-ins' address from the runner.

entries.name: MAIL_CATCHER_URL
entries.is: The local stack's Mailpit.

entries.name: ANDROID_HOME
entries.is: Where the Android SDK is.

entries.name: CI
entries.is: Set by GitHub Actions.

entries.name: GITHUB_ACTIONS
entries.is: Set by GitHub Actions.

entries.name: GITHUB_ENV
entries.is: Set by GitHub Actions: the file a step adds settings to.

entries.name: GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
entries.is: Set by GitHub Actions: the run's summary page.

entries.name: RUNNER_TEMP
entries.is: Set by GitHub Actions: the runner's own scratch folder.

entries.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
entries.is: The project's API address, built into the app; also a repository secret the web build reads.

entries.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
entries.is: The anon key, built into the app; also a repository secret a workflow reads.

entries.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY
entries.is: RevenueCat's public iOS SDK key, built into the app.

entries.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
entries.is: Sentry's address for the app's error reports, built into the app.

entries.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
entries.is: The project's API address, built into the website.

entries.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
entries.is: The anon key, built into the website.

entries.name: Supabase Auth SMTP key
entries.is: Resend's SMTP password Supabase Auth sends the House's emails with (smtp.resend.com).
entries.rotation: resend.com → a new API key for SMTP, paste it in Supabase's SMTP settings, send one reset email to yourself, then delete the old key.

entries.name: Supabase access token (CLI)
entries.is: The CLI login functions:check and every deploy use.
entries.rotation: supabase.com → Account → Access tokens: revoke, then npx supabase login again.

entries.name: RevenueCat App Store credentials
entries.is: The App Store in-app purchase key RevenueCat checks purchases with.
entries.rotation: App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → a new In-App Purchase key; upload it to RevenueCat; revoke the old one.

entries.name: RevenueCat Google Play credentials
entries.is: The Google Cloud service account RevenueCat checks Play purchases with (at launch prep, §3c-12).
entries.rotation: A new key for the service account in Google Cloud, uploaded to RevenueCat, the old key deleted.

entries.name: APNs key
entries.is: Apple's push key EAS holds for the app.
entries.rotation: Apple Developer → Keys → a new APNs key; eas credentials to set it; revoke the old key.

entries.name: FCM key
entries.is: Firebase's push key EAS holds for Android.
entries.rotation: Firebase → a new service account key, eas credentials to upload it, delete the old key.

entries.name: iOS signing credentials
entries.is: The distribution certificate and provisioning profile EAS manages, each with an expiry (read with eas credentials).
entries.rotation: eas credentials → remove and let EAS make new ones at the next build.

entries.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
entries.is: The Sentry upload key an EAS build uses to send source maps (P4.45).
entries.rotation: sentry.io → a new auth token with release rights, eas secret to replace it, revoke the old one.

entries.name: Supabase Metrics API key
entries.is: A secret key made for Grafana Cloud alone, for the database's alerts (P3.8); never the legacy service_role key.
entries.rotation: Project Settings → API Keys: a new secret key named for Grafana, set in Grafana, the old one deleted.

entries.name: Web-push VAPID private key
entries.is: The website's old web-push key, retired 2026-10-15; held until removed everywhere (P0.82).
entries.rotation: Retired: removed from every Vercel project and the root .env, never re-used.

entries.name: HEARTBEAT_CHECKIN_URL
entries.is: Sentry's cron check-in address, with the monitor's slug written as {monitor}: each scheduled workflow's heartbeat (scripts/heartbeat.mjs, register/alert-rules.json, WORKLIST P0.38).
entries.rotation: sentry.io → the project's client keys: a new key, the address rebuilt with it in the GitHub secret, the old key revoked.
